entities.summary: Antoine Somdah is a statesman of Burkina Faso and a diplomat. Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Burkina Faso to the Russian Federation from 2014 to January 2024. He was succeeded by Aristide Tapsoba on 31 January 2024.
